thread:
Emily (Support): Forwarding from Zendesk — Brightlane account. Invoice INV-2026-0421 is in 'On Hold' due to payment failure. Customer says AP declined because we didn't include their PO and the VAT/reverse-charge note. They want Net 45. @Nina can you confirm PO/contract?

Leo (Billing): I pulled the invoice. Total £12,480. System shows VAT applied as reverse charge but invoice missing customer's VAT reg number. We need PO number on invoice to satisfy their AP remittance rules.

Nina (AM): Brightlane submitted PO# PO-BR-4589 via Zendesk attachment. They say their standard vendor terms are Net45 and want us to honor that. Attached PDF looks like signed PO but I haven't matched amounts yet.

Raj (Finance): FYI, Net45 is an exception for new customers — requires finance lead approval. If they provide signed PO + valid VAT ID (proper format, e.g., GB999999973), we can tentatively release the hold and set Net30 while we process the exception. Without PO we require prepay.

Leo (Billing): What we need to clear: 1) confirm PO matches invoice name/amount; 2) verify VAT ID and whether reverse charge applies; 3) reissue invoice with PO and the tax note. Example invoice note we add: 

```
Reverse charge — Customer to account for VAT. Customer VAT ID: GB999999973. PO: PO-BR-4589.
```

Emily (Support): Customer asked if we can just reissue with PO and Net45 immediately. Any compliance/reg risk if we do without finance sign-off?

Raj (Finance): Risk: granting Net45 without approval sets a term precedent. Operational workaround: reissue as Net30 provisional on receipt of PO + VAT ID, and escalate for formal Net45 approval. If AM gets exec confirmation from Brightlane, we can fast-track.

Leo (Billing): To reissue run: 

```
billing.reissue(invoice='INV-2026-0421', note='PO PO-BR-4589 | Reverse charge | Net30 provisional')
```
Then set status to 'Pending Payment' so AP can remit. Capture PO in ticket.

InvoiceBot: Invoice INV-2026-0421 status changed to 'Pending Reissue' by Leo (Billing). :white_check_mark: 

Nina (AM): I'm on it — reached out to Brightlane AP to confirm PO amount and VAT ID. Asked for explicit acceptance of Net30 provisional or exec sign-off for Net45. ETA ~6 hours. Will paste signed PO link here once received. :eyes: 

Raj (Finance): If we don't have PO + VAT ID by EOD, we'll escalate to Sales Ops for exception review. Internal ref: finance/escalations. Also add a note to the account to prevent automated dunning until cleared.

Emily (Support): Thanks all — I'll reply to the Zendesk thread: reissuing invoice with PO and provisional Net30 upon receipt of signed PO and VAT ID; otherwise payment required to lift hold. Keeping customer updated. :thumbsup:
